items.program_name: 雇用創出税額控除(OH JCTC)
items.summary: Ohio Tax Credit AuthorityがPrentke Romich Companyに対し、Wayne County Township Woosterでの事業拡大に伴い雇用創出税額控除(JCTC)を承認。60人の新規雇用と年間$5.1Mの新規給与創出が条件。
items.infer: 支援機器・福祉機器メーカーとみられ、雇用拡大に伴い生産・組立設備の増強が行われる可能性がある(推論)。
items.verbatim: Ohio Tax Credit Authority approved a tax exemption (Data Center Sales Tax Exemption or JCTC-type exemption) of 1.468% for 8 years on 2025-10-27 for a project in Township Wooster, Wayne County. Commitment: create 60 full-time equivalent employees generating $5,100,000 in new annual payroll at the pro
